{{Quote|I'm done asking ''nicely'', maggot! Give me Vul Isen!''"<br />"''Jedi or not, I'll light your funeral pyre myself!|Cade Skywalker and the Sith Lord, as they duel|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
A ''' male''' was an [[Unidentified horn-row species|alien]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[138 ABY]]. After the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] ordered the execution of the [[Final Protocol]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]&mdash;which was [[Viral spore|poisoned]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]]&mdash;the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attempted to defend Isen's [[Vul Isen's laboratory|laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] when the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and his allies [[Mission to Daluuj|raided]] Isen's lair in an attempt to locate the "[[Vul Isen|Butcher of Dac]]." The Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Skywalker in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] on a bridge, with Skywalker gaining the upper hand and [[Cho mok/Legends|slicing off]] the [[Gender/Legends|man's]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. He was interrogated by Skywalker, who, after finding that the alien had no information as to Isen's whereabouts, left the man to [[Death/Legends|die]] when the explosives set by Skywalker's allies in the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] detonated.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tell you what&mdash;right now, my pyroman's inside setting this place to blow. You tell me where Isen is&mdash;where he keeps his toxins&mdash;and you get to live.''"<br />"''The truth will do you no good. This ''was'' Isen's lab, but he is no longer here&mdash;nor has he left his secrets behind. Vul Isen's knowledge is the source of his power, and he does not believe in sharing his power. The secrets to the planet-destroying toxins are Isen's alone.|Cade Skywalker and the Sith Lord|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
An [[Unidentified horn-row species|alien]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Answer" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Sith Lords">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19458&p=260318#p260318|thread=Question for John or Jan regarding all of Legacy's Sith|user=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2012-07-04|time=06:12}}</ref> served the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]] Order and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], having [[Death/Legends|killed]] numerous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Legacy 48" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[138 ABY]].<ref name="Leg49vsLegExt">Although the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]] states that its events take place in [[137 ABY]], the more recently released [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 10: Extremes|''Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes'' trade paperback]] dates those events at [[138 ABY]].</ref> Earlier, in [[137 ABY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]]<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>&mdash;who, as Krayt's [[Voice]], commanded the Empire when Krayt was incapacitated<ref name="SWLeg34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref>&mdash;ordered the [[Final Protocol]]'s execution, causing the [[Genocide on Dac|extermination]] of the majority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac's]] population.<ref name="Legacy 47" /> During these events, the Sith Lord was stationed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] at the [[Vul Isen's laboratory|laboratory]] of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]],<ref name="Legacy 48" /> who created the [[viral spore]]s that poisoned Dac's [[Water/Legends|waters]].<ref name="Legacy 47" />

[[File:Cade_duels_Sith_Leg_48.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Sith Lord duels Cade Skywalker on Daluuj.]]
Early in 138 ABY,<ref name="Leg49vsLegExt" /> the former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]] and his allies [[Mission to Daluuj|assaulted]] Isen's [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], in search of the scientist who had been nicknamed the "[[Vul Isen|Butcher of Dac]]." The Sith Lord attacked Skywalker and engaged him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] on the bridge leading to the laboratory, throughout which he taunted and demeaned the former Jedi. However, Skywalker evaded an attack from the Sith and [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] his [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. The wounded Sith Lord was interrogated by Skywalker about Isen's whereabouts, with Skywalker promising that the man would live if he gave them Isen's location. The Sith told him that the laboratory Skywalker had raided was indeed Isen's, but that the Givin scientist had abandoned it long ago, taking all evidence with him. He also revealed that Isen did not share his knowledge with anyone.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

When Skywalker instructed his crewmate [[Jariah Syn]] to detonate the explosives that he had set in the laboratory and began to flee with his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]], the Sith cursed Skywalker for what he believed to be a breach of the Jedi's word. However, he was reminded by Skywalker that the condition for his life was only if the Sith told him of Isen's location, and the Sith perished in the explosion after the explosives detonated.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Gaggalak mursto! You gave your ''word'', Skywalker, that I would live!''"<br />"If'' you told me where to find Isen. You ''didn't''.|The Sith Lord and Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
The individual was a male<ref name="Legacy 48" /> Sith Lord<ref name="Sith Lords" /> who had [[Color/Legends|red]] and black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] that covered his body, and long, flowing black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He had a spike pierced through his left [[Ear/Legends|ear]],<ref name="Legacy 48" /> and also had spike implants grafted on his [[Bone/Legends|skull]].<ref name="Answer" /> During [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], the Sith Lord used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] containing a red [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]]. He spoke and comprehended both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], using the latter to call Skywalker a "worm-eating liar." During his battle with Skywalker, he made it a point to insult the former Jedi, and also pontificated that he had slain Jedi more powerful than Skywalker. After being defeated by Skywalker, the Sith Lord divulged all the information he knew about Isen. He also cursed Skywalker when the former Jedi decided to leave him to die.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|I have killed more powerful Jedi than you! You are nothing! You are dead!|The Sith Lord, to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
The Sith Lord was skilled in combat with a lightsaber, briefly engaging Skywalker in a duel, and was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He had killed numerous Jedi by the time he fought Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Legacy48.jpg|thumb|right|175px|The Sith Lord appeared on the cover of ''Star Wars: Legacy 48: Extremes, Part 1''.]]
{{Quote|That Sith was human&mdash;with a lot of tats and some spike implants on his skull.|Jan Duursema, answering a fan's question regarding the Sith Lord's species|<ref name="Answer">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19441&p=260230#p260230|thread=Question for John or Jan regarding Legacy #48|user=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2012-06-26|time=08:55|quote=That Sith was human--with a lot of tats and some spike implants on his skull.}}</ref>}}
The Sith Lord was created by [[John Ostrander]], the writer of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. He first appeared in the series' [[Legacy (2006) 48|forty-eighth issue]],<ref name="Legacy 48" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2010]]<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-989/Star-Wars-Legacy-48---Extremes-Part-1|text=Star Wars: Legacy #48 - Extremes (Part 1)}}</ref> and served as the first issue in the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes|''Extremes'']] story arc. The cover for ''Extremes, Part 1'' depicted the man [[Jar'Kai/Legends|wielding two lightsabers]] while combating Cade Skywalker. However, the story itself presented him using only one lightsaber. [[Jan Duursema]], who penciled the Sith, later confirmed that all Sith who were tattooed in the ''Legacy'' comics held the title of Sith Lord and were [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]] in Darth Krayt's Empire,<ref name="Sith Lords" /> and also stated that he was a Human with spike implants grafted on his skull,<ref name="Answer" /> though this was eventually overruled by [[Leland Chee]] who revealed he classified the Sith Lord as an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] within the [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Leland Species 1" /><ref name="Leland Species 2" />
